guardrails: No report is not a clean negative.
A negative is limited to the area, visibility and time actually checked.
Reposts and news stories derived from one original social post share an independence group.
Post-event social material may verify an event but cannot leak into an earlier forecast feature.
Private/login-only material is not accessed or archived.
Copyrighted public media are not retained without explicit permission; structured factual observations and source URLs are retained.
purpose: Structured public human/social/media evidence for event labeling and observation-effort calibration. This is an evidence layer feeding the canonical event/control system, not a parallel event database.
